A new CAQM report submitted to the Supreme Court has exposed gaps in Delhi-NCR's efforts to tackle vehicular pollution. Of the 25.43 lakh identified end-of-life vehicles, only around 1.86 lakh were scrapped or moved out between January and October 2026. The report also highlights a shortage of EV charging infrastructure, with nearly 13 lakh electric vehicles sharing just 16,785 charging points across Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana and Rajasthan.
